_comment: Canonical typed read models for the passkey-scoped observability read API (/api/v1/observe). These are browser-session-authenticated, user-scoped, read-only projections. Controllers derive user_id from the validated cookie, ignore caller-supplied identity, cap limits, use stable cursors, and return canonical typed JSON. All models exclude null fields on the wire.

agent_state_projection._description: Current lifecycle state of a single agent persona in the roster. Combines the static persona registry projection with the current agent-state snapshot.

agent_id.description: Stable agent identifier matching the persona registry

role.description: Agent role or persona (e.g. triage, sage, dash, auditor, warden, scribe, judge)

run_id.description: Owning run identifier when the agent is bound to a run

task_id.description: Active task identifier when the agent is executing a task

model.description: Model identifier when the agent is configured with a model

throughput.description: Tokens-per-second measurement. Unavailable until a real measured source exists.

observed_at.description: UTC timestamp of the last status observation

overview_counters._description: Bounded overview counters for the dashboard header. Each counter carries a freshness label so the frontend can show stale or unavailable states honestly.

agents_running.description: Count of agents in active states as defined by the projection contract

tasks_in_queue.description: Count of tasks awaiting execution. Queue semantics are defined by the projection contract, not inferred from incomplete replay history.

success_rate.description: Aggregate success-rate measurement with metric ID, version, denominator, and verification status. Omitted when no eval or run aggregate exists.

overview_measurements._description: Resource and throughput measurements for the dashboard. Each card uses ObservedMeasurement with explicit status. Cards remain unavailable until a real host telemetry collector exists.

total_throughput.description: Aggregate tokens-per-second across matching windows and units. Omitted when no measured source exists.

cpu.description: Host CPU utilization from a target-scoped collector. Omitted when no collector exists.

ram.description: Host RAM utilization from a target-scoped collector. Omitted when no collector exists.

vram.description: GPU VRAM utilization from a target-scoped collector. Omitted when no collector exists.

disk.description: Host disk utilization from a target-scoped collector. Omitted when no collector exists.

run_summary._description: Paginated read-only run summary owned by the authenticated user. Uses stable run IDs, kinds, timestamps, terminal status, and evidence/receipt indicators.

has_receipts.description: Whether the run has at least one governance receipt

evidence_count.description: Number of evidence-safe artifacts associated with the run

run_task._description: A single task within a run detail projection.

owning_agent.description: Agent identifier owning this task when assigned

evidence_safe_link._description: An evidence-safe link in a run detail projection. Links to allowlisted download artifacts only; never exposes restricted prompts, model outputs, or governed evidence.

artifact_id.description: Download artifact identifier in the allowlisted catalog

label.description: Human-readable label for the evidence artifact

run_detail._description: Typed run detail projection with tasks and evidence-safe links. Owned by the authenticated user.

evidence_safe_links.description: Evidence-safe links to allowlisted download artifacts

eval_summary._description: Paginated eval run projection. Carries campaign dimensions (campaign_id, arm_ids, model_cohort_ids) so a multi-arm, multi-cohort campaign renders as one projection. Uses registered metrics with honest verification labels.

campaign_id.description: Campaign identity from the campaign manifest. Empty for single-arm diagnostic runs without campaign records.

arm_ids.description: All arm IDs in the campaign. A single-arm diagnostic carries one entry.

model_cohort_ids.description: All model cohort IDs in the campaign. Empty for single-arm diagnostic runs without campaign records.

verification_status.description: Honest verification boundary label. Never 'verified' until the complete verifier exists.

metric_count.description: Number of registered metrics in the projection

published_projection_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the persisted disclosure-safe projection. Omitted when no projection is published.

eval_metric_summary._description: A single registered metric in an eval detail projection, stratified by model cohort and arm.

model_cohort_id.description: Model cohort identity. Empty for single-arm diagnostic runs without campaign records.

arm_id.description: Arm identity for this metric stratum.

eval_detail._description: Typed eval detail projection with campaign dimensions, cohort-stratified aggregate metrics, status, and verification boundary. Model identity is per-cohort (carried via model_cohort_ids), not a single scalar. Extended with exact role-combination identity, benchmark/task population, arm, repetitions, terminal outcomes, missingness, dispositions, environment class, backend/artifact identity, quantization, and proof links.

campaign_id.description: Campaign identity from the campaign manifest. Empty for single-arm diagnostic runs without campaign records.

arm_ids.description: All arm IDs in the campaign. A single-arm diagnostic carries one entry.

model_cohort_ids.description: All model cohort IDs in the campaign. Empty for single-arm diagnostic runs without campaign records.

role_combination_id.description: Stable role-combination identifier binding exact Primary, Assistant, and Lite variant identities. Omitted for single-arm diagnostic runs without role combinations.

primary_variant_id.description: Exact Primary model variant ID. Omitted for single-arm diagnostic runs.

assistant_variant_id.description: Exact Assistant model variant ID. Omitted when the combination has no Assistant role.

lite_variant_id.description: Exact Lite model variant ID. Omitted when the combination has no Lite role.

benchmark_population.description: Number of benchmarks in the frozen benchmark population. Omitted for single-arm diagnostic runs.

repetition_count.description: Frozen repetition count. Omitted for single-arm diagnostic runs.

superseded_count.description: Number of superseded assignments in the cycle. Omitted when zero or not applicable.

qualification_count.description: Number of qualification outcomes in the cycle. Omitted when zero or not applicable.

unavailable_count.description: Number of unavailable assignments in the cycle. Omitted when zero or not applicable.

environment_class.description: Hardware environment class label from the frozen environment policy. Omitted for single-arm diagnostic runs.

backend_name.description: Backend name from the provider boundary. Omitted for single-arm diagnostic runs.

artifact_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the served artifact. Omitted for single-arm diagnostic runs.

quantization.description: Quantization policy. Omitted when no quantization is applied.

proof_links.description: Evidence-safe links to public proof artifacts. Omitted when no proof artifacts are published.

download_artifact._description: An allowlisted generated public-safe artifact in the download catalog. Has fixed content type, byte size, SHA-256 hash, privacy classification, and authenticated download URL.

artifact_id.description: Stable artifact identifier used in the download URL path

sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the artifact content for integrity verification

privacy_classification.description: Disclosure classification. Only public_safe artifacts appear in the browser catalog.

source_run_id.description: Run that produced this artifact when applicable

download_url.description: Authenticated download URL path relative to the Gateway base URL

observe_page._description: Pagination wrapper for paginated observe API responses. Uses stable cursors and bounded page sizes.

items.description: Page items. The item type depends on the endpoint (run_summary, eval_summary, download_artifact).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Omitted when there are no more results.

limit.description: Page size applied to this response

observe_bootstrap_snapshot._description: One bounded initial snapshot for first paint. Contains agents, active run, overview counters, recent runs, latest eval summaries, measurements, and download metadata. SSE provides incremental change notifications after the snapshot.

agents.description: Agent roster with current state snapshots

active_run.description: Currently active run for the authenticated user. Omitted when no run is active.

recent_runs.description: Bounded list of recent run summaries

latest_evals.description: Bounded list of latest eval summaries

observe_producer_agent_state_request._description: Typed request body for the mTLS producer endpoint POST /api/v1/observe/producer/agent-state. Carries AgentStatusUpdatedPayload fields plus the SSE routing target (exactly one of web_session_id or cli_session_id). The gateway derives user_id from the mTLS peer certificate, never from the request body.

agent_id.description: Stable agent identifier. The ensemble constructs this deterministically from user_id and persona_id to ensure cross-user uniqueness in the projection document key.

display_name.description: Human-readable agent name from the persona registry

run_id.description: Owning run identifier when the agent is bound to a run

task_id.description: Active task identifier when the agent is executing a task

model.description: Resolved model identifier. May be empty before model resolution.

observed_at.description: UTC timestamp of the state change from the ensemble's own clock

web_session_id.description: SSE routing target for browser sessions. Exactly one of web_session_id or cli_session_id is required.

cli_session_id.description: SSE routing target for CLI sessions. Exactly one of web_session_id or cli_session_id is required.

observe_producer_run_state_request._description: Typed request body for the mTLS producer endpoint POST /api/v1/observe/producer/run-state. Carries RunStatusUpdatedPayload fields plus the SSE routing target. The gateway derives user_id from the mTLS peer certificate, never from the request body.

run_id.description: Stable run identifier. For investigation runs, this is the investigation_id.

completed_tasks.description: Number of completed tasks in this run

total_tasks.description: Total number of tasks in this run

ended_at.description: Run end timestamp for terminal states

observed_at.description: UTC timestamp of the state change from the ensemble's own clock

web_session_id.description: SSE routing target for browser sessions. Exactly one of web_session_id or cli_session_id is required.

cli_session_id.description: SSE routing target for CLI sessions. Exactly one of web_session_id or cli_session_id is required.

observe_producer_response._description: Typed response body for the mTLS producer endpoints. Carries a single accepted flag indicating the gateway accepted and persisted the projection. Contains no record identifiers, ownership fields, or echo of the request payload.

accepted.description: Whether the gateway accepted and persisted the projection

supervisor_state_projection._description: Current lifecycle state of the continuous campaign supervisor. Combines the accepted specification reference with the current cycle and stop state. One supervisor per campaign.

campaign_id.description: Campaign identity from the campaign manifest

campaign_revision.description: Campaign revision from the frozen profile hash

current_cycle_id.description: Currently active cycle identifier. Omitted when idle or stopped.

last_cycle_id.description: Last completed cycle identifier. Omitted when no cycle has completed.

stop_reason.description: Typed stop reason when status is stopped or safety_stopped

observed_at.description: UTC timestamp of the last supervisor state observation

cycle_state_projection._description: Current lifecycle state of a single campaign cycle. One cycle at a time per supervisor. Carries exact role-combination identity and verification status.

campaign_id.description: Campaign identity from the campaign manifest

campaign_revision.description: Campaign revision from the frozen profile hash

role_combination_id.description: Stable role-combination identifier binding exact Primary, Assistant, and Lite variant identities

verification_status.description: Honest verification boundary label. Omitted until the verifier runs.

started_at.description: UTC timestamp when the cycle started. Omitted when queued.

completed_at.description: UTC timestamp when the cycle completed. Omitted when not terminal.

observed_at.description: UTC timestamp of the last cycle state observation

assignment_progress_projection._description: Current progress of a single campaign assignment. Carries exact variant, role, task, arm, and repetition identity with terminal status and disposition.

campaign_id.description: Campaign identity from the campaign manifest

variant_id.description: Model variant ID for this assignment

role.description: Model role exercised in this assignment

terminal_status.description: Terminal outcome status. Omitted when not terminal.

started_at.description: UTC timestamp when the assignment started. Omitted when queued.

completed_at.description: UTC timestamp when the assignment completed. Omitted when not terminal.

observed_at.description: UTC timestamp of the last assignment progress observation

role_combination_projection._description: Exact Primary/Assistant/Lite role-combination identity. Binds all three exact ModelVariant identities with served model tags, backends, and quantization from the provider boundary.

campaign_id.description: Campaign identity from the campaign manifest

assistant_variant_id.description: Exact Assistant model variant ID. Omitted when the combination has no Assistant role.

lite_variant_id.description: Exact Lite model variant ID. Omitted when the combination has no Lite role.

primary_model_tag.description: Served model tag for the Primary role

assistant_model_tag.description: Served model tag for the Assistant role. Omitted when the combination has no Assistant role.

lite_model_tag.description: Served model tag for the Lite role. Omitted when the combination has no Lite role.

primary_backend.description: Backend name for the Primary role

assistant_backend.description: Backend name for the Assistant role. Omitted when the combination has no Assistant role.

lite_backend.description: Backend name for the Lite role. Omitted when the combination has no Lite role.

primary_quantization.description: Quantization policy for the Primary role. Omitted when no quantization is applied.

assistant_quantization.description: Quantization policy for the Assistant role. Omitted when no quantization is applied or no Assistant role.

lite_quantization.description: Quantization policy for the Lite role. Omitted when no quantization is applied or no Lite role.

observed_at.description: UTC timestamp of the role-combination observation

verification_progress_projection._description: Current progress of the campaign verifier for a single cycle. Carries verification status, verified index generation hash, layer count, and failure count.

campaign_id.description: Campaign identity from the campaign manifest

verified_index_generation_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the verified index generation. Omitted until verification completes.

layer_count.description: Total number of verification layers checked

completed_at.description: UTC timestamp when the verifier completed. Omitted when still running.

observed_at.description: UTC timestamp of the last verification progress observation

publication_progress_projection._description: Current progress of the publication path for a single cycle. Carries publication status, schema version, and published projection hash.

campaign_id.description: Campaign identity from the campaign manifest

publication_schema_version.description: Publication schema version. Omitted until publication completes.

published_projection_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the persisted disclosure-safe projection. Omitted until publication completes.

completed_at.description: UTC timestamp when the publication completed. Omitted when pending or failed.

observed_at.description: UTC timestamp of the last publication progress observation

source_freshness_projection._description: Current freshness state of the campaign source. A heartbeat proves source liveness only, not that any specific work is progressing. Freshness transitions are typed from a closed vocabulary.

campaign_id.description: Campaign identity when the source is bound to a campaign. Omitted when the source is idle.

last_heartbeat_at.description: UTC timestamp of the last heartbeat observation

observed_at.description: UTC timestamp of the last freshness observation
